newsitem.title: USA: Intel says to buy Chips and Technologies.
newsitem.headline: Intel says to buy Chips and Technologies.

text.p: Intel Corp said it entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Chips and Technologies Inc, based in San Jose, California.
The acquisition is aimed at advancing capabilities for graphics and visual computing in mobile personal computers, a news release issued by Intel said.
The terms of the agreement provide for Intel to commence a cash tender offer in the near future for all outstanding shares of Chips and Technologies at a price of $17.50 per share, Intel said.
Shares of Chips and Technologies last traded at $14.
Intel said it and Chips and Technologies have a working relationship based on their joint efforts in graphics accelerators.
Intel said the acquisition will provide it with the ability to bring strong graphics solutions to the mobile market segment.
Chips and Technologies will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Intel Corp and part of Intel's Graphics Components Division, Intel said.
Jim Stafford, Chips and Technologies' president and chief executive officer, will join Intel as a vice president of the company's Desktop Products Group, Intel said.
Current Chips and Technologies employees will become employees of Intel and Intel said it does not anticipate any immediate changes to Chips and Technologies' product line.
